title: Decisions: the product has no risk tiers
body:
**Intent:** record a maintainer decision. Risk tiers belong to how this repo merges its own PRs, not to the open source product. Review policy is up to the org that owns the PRs.

**Behavior change:** none. One line in the "Decided by the maintainer" section of `backlog/decisions.md`. The product has no tiers today; this keeps it that way.

**Tier 0:** `backlog/` only.

**Known gaps:** none.
